tool_args.rationale: Across all eight paid rows, y/u_now is approximately 2.083 with very small scatter despite variation in x_now, mem_conv, u_past, and H. A numerically fitted static affine-in-u_now model captures the evident law with two parameters and avoids unsupported transient complexity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; 8 rows now show a stable proportional relationship across differing x_now, mem_conv, and H.
Would require additional fitted parameters and predicts dependence on x_now/mem_conv/H that is not evident; outputs instead track u_now nearly exactly.
Observed response is proportional to u_now despite varying u_past; no need to add relaxation parameters.
Irrelevant to the observed law and explicitly not worth its cost.
